title: Extract WFC Plugin
description: Extract wave function collapse from the procedural plugin (assembly artifact wfc-engine inference) into its own `✏️s/🔌️plugins/🌊️wfc` plugin with five artifacts: bitmap (overlapping-model input/output bitmap editor), 2d-grid (regular rectangular grid, fixed left/right/top/bottom neighbours, vector/bitmap tiles, grid canvas + 2d preview), 2d (arbitrary-neighbour graph, non-rectangular shape, graph-with-slots editor + 2d preview), 3d-grid (regular non-uniform box grid, six fixed neighbours, mesh tiles, grid box + 3d preview), 3d (arbitrary-neighbour graph, mesh tiles, graph-with-slots editor + 3d preview).
summary: Wave function collapse extracted from the procedural plugin's assembly artifact into its own `🀄️wfc` plugin (crate semio-s-plugin-wfc, package semio:wfc; 🌊️ was refused because it folds onto the sibling 🌊️flow emoji) with five artifacts — bitmap (🖼️bitmap, overlapping model: input bitmap → locally similar output bitmap, two Canvas2d windows), 2d-grid (🔲️grid2d, four fixed neighbours, vector/bitmap/image-child tiles, grid canvas + 2d preview), 2d (◻️2d, arbitrary named-relation graph, graph-with-slots NodeGraph window + 2d preview), 3d-grid (🧱️grid3d, six fixed neighbours, non-uniform per-axis cell sizes, mesh tiles, World3d grid box + 3d preview) and 3d (🧊️3d, arbitrary graph, mesh tiles, the byte-identical wfc-graph window + 3d preview). The 10 kLOC engine moved verbatim into the shared crate semio-s-plugin-wfc-engine with 34 formerly test-gated modules promoted to production; the procedural plugin is assembly-free (folder deleted, 22 referrers rewired, descriptor regenerated). Every solve is a resumable inference (WfcJob) and every editor was proven live in the React playground (boot/interact/viewer probes with zero fault lines for all five: example switching without phantom edits, pin/mask/paint/drag gestures landing as single undoable edits, visible solves). Final gates: engine 301 tests, bitmap 185, grid2d 211, wfc2d 190, grid3d 207, wfc3d 239, plugin lib 14 incl. descriptor freshness, close_ladder 11/11, boot_deadline, idle_turns, wasm32-wasip2 check, describe (10 apps, 13 examples), plugin-registry:generate, schema generate, wfc-js 148 TS tests, dag-js and renderer lint all green. Along the way the fleet fixed real engine/framework bugs: two retained payloads per CommitCandidate, closing-gated terminal_is_empty spin, one payload page per step, unsatisfiable published as a Fault, a D4 symmetry-order bug, a silently ignored rename_all, missing store owners/disposers in editors and viewers, a process-wide idle-turn heap witness, the wasm NodeGraph surface never committing drags/wires, and three inadmissible taxonomy emoji. Open, owned elsewhere: verify taxonomy and policy are unrunnable repo-wide (stale distribution-manifest input path, missing repo-client binary), plugin-registry:check keeps 54 repo-endemic wfc findings (config/presence schema leaves, mounted-test dirs), the MCP inference test target does not compile on peer errors so its assembly→wfc fixture swap is unverified by execution, four viewers do not declare setActiveExample (harmless boot warning), and headless probes cannot draw a wire on the wasm graph canvas.
note: Ticket bookkeeping manual on disk: repo MCP failed to connect on 2026-09-18.
